title: The complexity of smooth words over binary alphabets
summary: Smooth sequences over an alphabet of positive integers $\{a,b\}$ are sequences that are infinitely derivable, the emblematic example being the Oldenburger-Kolakoski sequence $κ$ over $\{1,2\}$. The main way to study their language is to consider a finite version of smooth sequences called smooth words.
